description: The tester's tool stack, the commit-time test options and the per-scope test-run policy. The tool list is read-only here and changes only through the tester's user-approval flow; the two commit_* keys and the three test_run_* keys are plain strings you can set.

keys.label: Test tools
keys.description: One entry per test type (unit, integration, e2e, sast, vulnerability, performance, coverage); changed only with the user's approval.
keys.pointer: agents/tester.md (Tool Stack Management: tools are added only with user approval)

keys.label: Commit test prompt default
keys.description: The answer j.commit's test prompt assumes without asking: skip, scoped or full; empty means no recorded default, so it always prompts.

keys.label: Commit test scope map file
keys.description: Relative path to the .json file mapping changed paths to the tests a scoped commit-time run executes; no leading slash and no .. segment.

keys.label: Task test run
keys.description: Which test run must pass before a task is closed: none runs no suite beyond the tester's own tests, scoped runs only the suites mapped from the changed files, full runs the whole catalog.

keys.label: Story test run
keys.description: Which test run must pass before a story is closed: none runs no suite beyond the tester's own tests, scoped runs only the suites mapped from the changed files, full runs the whole catalog.

keys.label: Epic test run
keys.description: Which test run must pass before an epic is closed: none runs no suite beyond the tester's own tests, scoped runs only the suites mapped from the changed files, full runs the whole catalog.
